data: A MEASUREMENT DOCUMENT (the design review's priced page TENSOR-READ-FORM.md fa3cd133c; the project's order 15 October 2026 08:1x UK), version 23 TENSOR: the hash's work is keyed 256-byte reads feeding INT8 matrix multiplies with INT32 accumulation. THE STATE: 4 matrices of 16 x 16 INT8 (1 KiB), drawn per hash from the init BLAKE3(Tensor/init || E || period_seed || S) expanded by the fold chain, and a read word. THE STEP (128 steps): one keyed item (256 bytes) at index fchain(x, 8192 + t) mod items, read as the 16 x 16 INT8 matrix B_t in row order; the hash's drawn sequence (a permutation of the 4 matrices a step, Fisher-Yates by fchain over the work seed's words) routes the chain: in the permutation's order C = S[p_j] x B_t (INT8 x INT8 products summed into INT32 over k = 0..15 ascending; every partial sum within +-262,144, so the sum is exact in any order and on every unit), then THE FIXED FOLD on the lanes (lane i the matrix row, the only lane work): S[p_j][i][k] = byte 3 of fmix32(uint32(C[i][k]) + (old byte << 24) + (j + 1) x 0x9E3779B9), and the read word x = fchain(x ^ C[0][0] ^ C[15][15], j) after every multiply, so the next step's read depends on all four multiplies (the routing confined to the fold, the page's 2.0x to 2.8x case). THE LEAN FIXED COST: the init one BLAKE3 (104 bytes in), the mix BLAKE3(Tensor/mix || E || period_seed || 16 lanes x 16-byte accumulators over their rows of the four matrices), the final digest. THE PERIOD SEED as F-141's chain form (period_blocks 64, the anchor at finality depth 64, chain 7358): it seeds the init, so the state is the period's and the hash's. Half and half by the count below on the 5090's measured rows.
counters: MULTIPLY-ACCUMULATES A HASH: 128 steps x 4 tiles x 16 x 16 x 16 = 2,097,152 INT8 x INT8 -> INT32 (the trace prints them). BYTES READ A HASH: 128 keyed items x 256 bytes = 32,768 (plus the fold's 131,072 single-byte lane operations and 512 read-word chains). THE EXACT CLASS: INT8 (signed, two's complement) products accumulated in INT32, the partial sums bounded by 16 x 128 x 128 = 262,144, exact and order-free on NVIDIA from Turing (mma.sync s8), AMD RDNA 3 and later and CDNA (WMMA/MFMA i8), Intel Arc's XMX (dpas s8) and in the reference's scalar loop; FP16 refused (the accumulation vendor-defined). THE ENERGY COUNT (the page's rows): the multiplies 2.1 million MACs at 2.2 to 2.4 pJ = 4.6 to 5.0 uJ, the reads 128 x 36 to 44 nJ = 4.6 to 5.6 uJ: 9.2 to 10.6 uJ a hash on the 5090 at the fold-every-8 multiply figure, half and half; at the routed 26 pJ a MAC the multiply half would be 55 uJ, which the fold-only routing is built to avoid; the GPU team's row as mined decides.
fits_die_sram_7nm: no (the gigabyte 8.6 Gbit); a chip's SRAM an attempt 2.3 KiB
